presentation.summary: Connect this Silo server to Memberra for automatic customer accounts.
presentation.description_markdown: Keeps an outbound, signed connection to your Memberra operator account. Memberra creates, suspends, restores and deletes customer accounts on this server, sets their libraries and applies package limits (streams, transcoding, downloads and remote bitrate). No inbound port or public URL is needed, and nothing else runs on the server: the plugin accepts only Memberra's fixed account commands and never manages Silo admin accounts.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. In Silo, create an API key while signed in as an admin.
2. In Memberra, open **Infrastructure → Silo plugin**, press **Pair a Silo server** and copy the one-time code.
3. Open this plugin's settings, paste the pairing code and the admin API key, and save.
4. Press **Check connection**. The server appears in Memberra within a few seconds.

The pairing code is used once; afterwards the plugin keeps a revocable token in Silo's encrypted plugin state. Revoke it from Memberra at any time.

capabilities.description: Starts the Memberra connection when Silo starts and checks that it is still running.

fields.description: One-time code from Memberra (Infrastructure → Silo plugin). Only needed to pair or re-pair.

fields.label: Silo URL
fields.description: Where the plugin reaches this server's API. The default works when the plugin runs inside Silo.
